focal_entities.audience: rn's makers, reading the issue on lovaizu/ccpm, who build rn for all its users

goal_orientation.purpose: deciding how rn changes so that every user's later work meets the need

constraints.decision: Learning: rn.py decide keeps any number of decisions for a work, but rn.py proposal refuses a sign-off for a work with more than 5, and a done task's work can no longer be changed, so the design sign-off cannot be shown
